status: frozen before access to licensed DEAP files
objective: Emotion recognition with the Z15's unchanged eight-electrode montage and participant-independent evaluation
reference: Cyton: left ear SRB2, right ear BIAS; DEAP: common-average reference, requiring domain-shift validation
dataset: licensed DEAP preprocessed Python, 32 participants, 40 trials per participant
label_policy: trial self-rating <5 is low, >5 is high, exactly 5 is excluded; never infer game labels as personal emotion labels
development_subjects: s01-s24, used only for participant-level model selection and tuning
untouched_holdout_subjects: s25-s32, evaluated once after all choices are fixed
window_policy: remove the 3-second pre-stimulus baseline; split each 60-second trial into five non-overlapping 12-second windows; all windows inherit their parent trial's self-rating
primary_metric: mean per-participant balanced accuracy on each binary task, with per-participant scores and macro-F1
initial_methods: four-band (4–43 Hz) log power + linear classifier
four-band (4–43 Hz) regularized log covariance + SVM
four-band (4–43 Hz) tangent-space covariance + linear classifier
quality-aware covariance as a separately evaluated robustness variant
adaptation_policy: new-user adaptation may use only a declared early calibration segment; report its duration, whether labels were used, and latency; never fit on future test windows
deployment_policy: the Z15 performs acquisition, filtering, quality control and inference locally; browser is display only; ARM-only baseline precedes any PL/Verilog accelerator
hypothesis: spatial covariance or tangent-space features improve participant-independent balanced accuracy over band power for the unchanged eight channels
falsification: no paired improvement on development participants, or holdout degradation versus the simpler baseline
limitations: DEAP's headset, reference and controlled video stimuli differ from a live Cyton session
official preprocessed DEAP is already high-pass filtered near 4 Hz; delta-band comparisons require separately licensed raw files
one trial-level self-rating is inherited by multiple windows and is not a direct per-window emotion label
offline DEAP accuracy alone cannot establish Cyton or FPGA accuracy
